module: Flowgraph node "On Bigmap Poi" (category repeat_instant): detects the selection of a point of interest on the big map. Outputs: "selected" and "deselected" (pulses), "poiId" (string), "navigated" and "denavigated" (pulses), "pos" (navigated vec3). Fed by the hooks onPoiSelectedFromBigmap and onSetBigmapNavFocus.
notes: Pulses last one frame: work() resets them to false then applies the received flags.

init.desc: Initializes the flags and the position.

onPoiSelectedFromBigmap.desc: Hook: POI selected (poiId) or nil if deselected.

onSetBigmapNavFocus.desc: Hook: navigation to pos, or nil if cancelled.

pos.desc: Target position, nil if the navigation is cancelled.

work.desc: Resets the pulses to false, applies the flags recorded by the hooks then clears them and writes poiId and pos.
